content: Jesus Tahi Ahekotyaha Aisahene Maheta
Hatyaoseta Jesus miyatya hatyoharenai tahi haxaotyakira hoka nexa haxaotyakiraharenai hiye:
— Waiyekehalakita atyo xomana: Hinamaki ferakene taitehena atyo hoka hisehaliti Páscoa tyaohena. Hoka Haliti Ityanite kamatawatyakehena atyalihose xaimaholatyaka hiye kaberekotyaka maheta.
Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohasenai, judeu nityohalitiranaiha harenai ahohisakoatyakakoaha xekohaseti Caifás hanako.
Hoka ahekotyaha: hametenetaha otokaha Jesus hoka aisahene aokowiha.
Xakore hoka nehenaha: — Maisaiya nikare wisaonita hisehaliti xowaka, waiya aliya hoka halitinai xalijinihare tyaona — nexaha.
Jesus Tyaonita Wenakalati Betânia Nali
Hoka Jesus wenakalati Betânia nali tyaonita jijikoahiti tawanehare Simão hanako hoka
hatya ohiro kaoka enomana airaxero karore kahekoalo. Hoka Jesus kanakairita ene hoka eseri heno airaxero owika.
Hoka exaotyakiraharenai waiyaha hatyoharenai hoka ehareha hoka nexaha: — Xoanere hoka nikare tyaonita? Hiyaiya, airaxero meta.
Ikoiya atyo airaxero kabetetyaka kalo xaimane hoka hatyo oloiya kaxekaka maoloxaharenai ana! nexaha.
Hoka Jesus ana waiyekehalakita iniraineha hoka nehena: — Xoana hoka xexamaikohalonikijita exe ohiro? Hiyaiya, waiyexe atyo tyoma nomani.
Hiyaiya, maoloxaharenai atyoite tyaota mene xinekoni hoka natyoiya atyo maisa notyaoneta minita xinekoni.
Nokamani nahitita atyo tyoa airaxeharetya noháre, noxafityaki niyahare.
Aliterexe nomita xihiye: tyotya hakakoare Iraiti Waiyexe kaxakaisakehena nali atyoite kaxakaisaka exe tyomehenere nomani hoka otyaxemahenahitahaite exe ohiro.
Judas Matawahena Jesus
Hatyaoseta 12-hare exaotyakiraharenai konitare, Judas Iscariotes nexarexe, xane iraehena sacerdotenai xekohasenai kakoa
hoka nehena: — Xoanereya xabakatya natyo hoka namatawatya Jesus xomana? nexa. Hatyaoseta ihatyaha 30 hokose olo prata nomaka hoka isaha enomana.
Hatyo najikinita Judas ahekohena Jesus hamatawala tahi akiti kakoa.
Jesus Otyaxematya Páscoa Ferakene

Hatyaoseta hetatiye ferakene hisehaliti nakairati makaorehetyakahare kakanakairatyaka aokahitere xowaka xane hikoa. Hoka exaotyakiraharenai xaneha Jesus haliya hoka axahene: — Aliye nali wisoma nakairati hisehaliti Páscoa niyahare haokita? nexaha.

Hoka nexa ihiyeha: — Xiyanehena wenakalati xeta hoka xatawa hatya haliti hoka xexa ihiye: “Xekohaseti nexa: ‘Noferakini xane hikoa. Noxaotyakiriharenai, natyo harenaite wotyaxemahena Páscoa ferakene hihanako’ ”, xexa.
Hatyaoseta exaotyakiraharenai Jesus aokitere akereta tyaonaha hoka tyomaha nakairati Páscoa niyahare.
Maka hoka Jesus 12-hare haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa tyoka kanakairaha maheta.
Kanakairahita hoka Jesus nehena: — Aliterexe nomita xihiye: hatya xinekonitare ite matawahena natyo — nexa.
Nexa hoka kalore amaikohareha hoka hatya xakini axehenaha Jesus: — Xoana maisa natyo xini haokita? nexaha.
Hoka Jesus nehena: — Hatya nohakakoani balatoahekoa maikitere nakairatite matawahena natyo.
Haliti Ityanite wainihena Iraiti Waiyexe iraetere akereta, xakore hoka kirakoane atyoite tyaohena Haliti Ityani matawahenere! Waiye kaiserehareya atyo mawenanehareta tyaonare! nexa.
Hatyaoseta Judas, ematawatyasehare, axehenene: — Xaotyakisatiye, xoana maisa natyo xini haokita? nexa. — Hoka hisota atyo nikare hiraeta — nexa Jesus ihiye.
Jesus Aimenekotya Nakairati, Erati Kakoa Hakamane
Kanakairahitaha hoka Jesus iya nakairati hoka iraexatya Enore hiye. Hatyaoseta taikasetene hoka isene haxaotyakiraharenai ana hoka nehena: — Xotohena hoka xikanakaira. Exe atyo noháre — nexa.
Hatyaoseta iyehitiya erakakalati hoka iraexahitiya Enore hiye. Hatyaoseta isene haxaotyakiraharenai ana hoka nehena: — Xiserehena xityotya inira xakini.
Hiyaiya, exe atyo notimalaxi, kaxiratyakehenere kahare haliti wanahiya, kaxemaisatyakeheta maheta iniyalahare enómaneha. Exe timalati hiyeta atyo waitare wenati tyaoheta halitinai ana Enore kakoa.
Aliterexe nomita xihiye: exaoseta atyoite maisa noterehitita exehare vinhoxa xikakoa. Xakore hoka noterehitiya atyoite waitarexa vinhoxa xikakoa Baba nawenakala nali — nexa.
Hatyaoseta xeraha haxaka xerati hoka xaneha Oliveiras tyairiya nali.
Jesus Irae Pedro Kakoa
Hoka hatyo nali Jesus nexa: — Exe xatinite xisekoahena, xahalakihena natyo. Hiyaiya, iraiti waiyexe kaxairatyakehenere atyo nexa:
Xakore hoka nokasehetehenere najikinitaite noxani xaheta maniya Galiléia xeta — nexa ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta Pedro nehena Jesus hiye: — Maisaiya atyo natyo nahalakijita hiso, exahe haiyanai nikare tyaona hoka — nexa.
Hoka Jesus nexa Pedro hiye: — Aliterexe nomita hihiye: awisa xatinite, takoira makawiraharenetaite, hanamaki hateraharetyoa, himawaiyaneneharene ite haoka natyo — nexa.
Hoka Pedro nexa: — Maisaiya xoana hekota nomawaiyanihare naokita hiso, exahite kotare nowaini hihakakoane — nexa. Tyotya exaotyakiraharenai nikare makere iraeha.
Jesus Tyaonita Imekoa Getsêmani Nali
Hatyaoseta Jesus xane haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa Getsêmani aokahitere nali hoka nexa: — Alita xisokehena hoka noxani exe waheta maniya hoka niraexatya — nexa.
Hatyaoseta noloka Pedro, hinamahare Zebedeu ityaninai xoaha hoka hatyo nali Jesus haxamaikoharene kehexa, exahe hamawaiyeharene,
hoka nehena: — Kalore noxamaikohalini nokihixita nohiye, motya aijita ene natyo. Alitehena xiso hoka xikaose hoka xiyaiyahokotyoa nohakakoani — nexa ihiyeha.

Nexa hoka xanehitiya sekose aka hoka meholokoa hatiho kakoa waikoa hoka iraexatya: — Abá, haokitaiya atyo hoka hemaisaheta noniti exe erakakalati noxemakawatikisase. Xakore hoka maisaiya atyo naokitere akereta xini kaomaka hoka maika atyo haokitere akereta kaomaka — nexa.
Hatyaoseta haikoaheta hoka waiyehena atyo, hanamahare exaotyakiraharenai atyo nemakita hoka nehena Pedro hiye: — Xoana maisaiya ini hekoti xikaose hoka xiyaiyahokotyoita nohakakoani? nexa.
Xikaose hoka xiraexatya, maisa xikahasakaharetyakita maheta. Xiyahekola atyo waiye maniya tyaonita, xakore hoka xiháre atyo maisa kinaterexe — nexa.
Hatyaoseta xane iraexahitiya ihinamakinihena hiye hoka nehena: — Abá, exe erakakalati noxemakawatikisaseya maisa kaxemaisatyakehitita nomaeraninihareta hoka maika haokitere akeretaite kaomaka — nexa.
Hatyaoseta haikoaheta haxaotyakiraharenai ana hoka nemakahitataha waiyahene. Enemakaha kalore kaweta hoka maisa aliyakere kaosexeha.
Hatyaoseta Jesus xanehitiya enonyahitaha hoka ehanamakinihena hiye iraexahenere akereta iraexahitiya.
Hatyaoseta haikoaheta haxaotyakiraharenai ana hoka nehena: — Xoana xisemakitata, xikawinitata? Xasemehena, enaose xane hikoa hoka Haliti Ityani atyo kamatawatyakehena iniyalahare nomaseharenai ana.
Xatityoahetehena hoka wiyaneheta. Xiyaiya, owene haliti nomatawatyasehare kaokehena — nexa.
Jesus Kaberexotyaka

Jesus iraetata ene hoka Judas kaoka, hatyo 12-hare exaotyakiraharenai konitare. Kahare haliti tyoa exema, kesekase, atyalihose harenai kakoare. Sacerdotenai xekohasenai, exahe judeunai nityohalitiranai xoaha xaxikala xema tyoahitaha.
Ematawatyasehare koxaka irae ekakoaha hoka aimenekohena hoka nehena: — Nasohitanakolihenerira xotoka, hatyo terota atyo — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Judas kaoka hoka xane Jesus haliya hoka nehena: — Xoana waiye hisaonita, Xaotyakisatiye? nexa hoka sohitanakolisene.
Hoka Jesus nehena ihiye: — Nohinaehare, xoare xamani atyo hisoma haokowita hoka hisomehenene rotita! nexa. Hatyaoseta kaokaha hoka otokaha Jesus hoka olatyahene.
Hatyaoseta hatya Jesus haliya tyaonitere iya kesekase hoka mokotya sacerdote xekohasehare wakanehare hoka aikotya itinihe.
Hoka Jesus nehena: — Hamohetehena hikeserakase. Hiyaiya, xala xamaniya atyo kesekase kakoa aisa hoka hatyohare kakoitaiya atyo kaxaisaka.
Xoana hiyahekola hiye ala, Baba naxa kahinaetya natyo maheta hoka motyaiyala maisa 12-hotyali anjonai axikaita nomani haokita?
Xakore hoka nikareya notyaona hoka aliyakereya Iraiti Waiyexe nali xakaihenere akereta kawenatyakehena? nexa.

Hatyaoseta Jesus nehena halitinai hiye: — Xoana hoka xisoa xotohena natyo maheta hoka kesekase, atyalihose harenai kakoa xisoa nomani hoka haliti xalijiniharexe akereta xamoka natyo? Hiyaiya, ferakiti nihatyaka notyaonita xikakoa Iraexatyakalati Hanako, xakore hoka maisa atyo xotokare natyo.
Exakere xakore atyo xamokita natyo hoka iraeti xakaisaseharenai xairahenere Iraeti Waiyexe nanekoa akereta atyo kawenatyaka maheta — nexa. Hatyaoseta exaotyakiraharenai halakisa Jesus hoka tekoaha.
Jesus Kakolatyaka Kalorexenai Nahalakoa
Hatyaoseta Jesus xotokasenai kolatene sacerdotenai xekohase, Caifás nexarexe hana nali. Hatyo nali koxaka hohisakoaha xaotyakiyaho kakoa waiyoreterenai, judeunai nityohalitiranai xoaha.
Hoka Pedro xane Jesus xema sekoseta sacerdotenai xekohasehare hana talala hoko kijiya. Isoa hoka tyoka sorarenai haliya waiya maheta, aliyakere xamani mohenaha Jesus hoka.
Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohaseharenai, tyotya kalorexenai xoaha semaha aokowiha xoalinihare maoserare Jesus tahi hoka aisahene aokowihenaha.
Xakore hoka maisa xoarehare semahitaha etahi. Kahareha xakore tityoaha hoka iraeha hamaoseralaha etahi hoka. Hatyaoseta hinamahare haliti maoseratyaliyenai tityoa hoka nehenaha:
— Exe haliti atyo exakere irai: “Nahatahetaiya Enore anere Iraexatyakalati Hana hoka notyomeheteniya hanamaki ferakene kakoita”, nexa.
Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohasehare tityoa hoka axehena Jesus: — Xoana, maisaite xoare hiraeta exe hiraeharetyaka nahalakoa? nexa.

Nexa xakore hoka Jesus mema tyaona. Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohasehare axehitiyene: — Kasani hekoaxatya nomani naoka. Hiyaiya, Enore haotita niraeta hikakoa. Xoana hiso Enore Kalorexe Aohenere, Enore Ityani? nexa.

Hoka Jesus nexa: — Hiso atyo nikare hiraeta. Xakore hoka aliterexe atyo niraeta xihiye: exaoseta atyoite xiyaiyehena Haliti Ityani nokane Enore kinaterexe fihini maniya, exahe exexoaneheta enokoata kaiminiti konita — nexa.

Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohasehare halalaka haima (hotikisa maheta haxamaikoharene) hoka nehena: — Iniyalahare atyo irae! Maisaiya atyo xoare maheta etahi akiti hatya xakai wihiye waohitita! Hiyaiya, xasema atyo iniyalahare iniraene Enore tahi!
Hoka xoanaite wamohenene? nexa. Hoka nehenaha: — Nikare iniyalahare atyo irae hoka waiye xaisaka.
Hatyaoseta xatahotihotyahene, exahe itihokoa mokohenahene hoka
nexahitaha: — Hotehena “Enore Kalorexe Aohenere”: xalatya mokotya hiso? nexaha.
Pedro Hamawaiyanenehare Aoka Jesus
Hatyo xowaka Pedro tyokita menanaka wetekokoa hoka sacerdotenai xekohasehare wakanehalo hikoa enomana hoka nehena: — Hiso tehitiya ene Jesus Galiléia yere xema hisaonita — nexa.
Hoka Pedro teraharetyoahena hoka tyotyaha ehaotitaha nehena: — Maisa atyo waiyekehalakere nomani hatyo hiraetere — nexa.
Hatyaoseta xane hatyo wetekokoa xisoakala nali hoka hatya wakahalo waiyehitiyene hoka nehena nali tyaoniterenai hiye: — Exe haliti atyo Jesus Nazaré yere xema ene tyaonita — nexa.
Nexa hoka Pedro teraharetyoahitiya: — Aliterexe naokita, maisa atyo nowaiyanihare xini hatyo haliti! nexa.
Hatyo najikinita nali tyaoniterenai xane kaokaha Pedro haliya hoka nehenaha ihiye: — Hiraene hiyeta atyo hawaiyekehalakahare. Hiso tehitiya atyo aliterexe enekonitareha — nexaha.

Hatyaoseta Pedro nehena: — Aliterexe niraeta, maisa hatyo haliti nowaiyanihare xini! Ikoiya namaoseraita hoka ehekoretaiya Enore hatyohare hiyeta iniyalahare moka natyo — nexa. Hatyo xowaka takoira kawihena

hoka Pedro oteheta Jesus niraene: “Takoira makawiraharenetaite hanamaki hateraharetyoa hoka himawaiyanenehare ite haoka natyo”, nehenere. Hatyaoseta Pedro kikisoaheta hatyo nalita hoka tiya, kalore amaikohare hoka.
